scope: Hoenn actor and coordinate roots; mainland ordinary fixed terminal speech. No claim of exhaustive full-game coverage.

comparison.method: AST literal add rows plus current contexts sources; unpublished companion modules included; no modules imported.

rules: Battle intro/defeat text is not a field terminal.
Named registration speech remains effective after generic PokeNav receipt; generic system receipt itself is not bound.
Pokemon visible meaningful speech may qualify; pure cries do not.
A reachable label is not proof of finality. Unresolved inventory remains explicit.
Preserve canonical World Living Hoenn 17 rare and 21 paired scene comment hooks.
Root owns object/sign/narration coverage; other agent owns Frontier/League/postgame.

	removeitem ITEM_SHOAL_SHELL, 4

	setflag FLAG_TEMP_2  @ Not read. Perhaps meant to stop him from re-explaining the Shell Bell if multiple are received in one sitting.
